# Maestro documentation map

This directory documents the compatibility-first governance layer of Orquestrador Maestro.

- README.md: navigation and compatibility promise.
- guide.md: complete onboarding and conceptual guide.
- testing.md: local, package, governance, and benchmark verification.
- compatibility.md: defaults, config precedence, warnings, and cost.
- governance-modes.md: compatibility versus strict behavior.
- models-and-tone.md: provider, model, profile, prompt, and tone preservation.
- user-impact.md: final-user risks and mitigations.
- operations.md: daily commands and troubleshooting.
- upgrade.md: safe update, backups, and rollback.
- config.example.json: reference configuration.
- assets/: versioned SVG diagrams.
- interaction-profiles.md: interaction configuration, precedence, status, and projection.

Core implementation references:

- runtime/governance/compatibility.js
- runtime/config/maestro-paths.js
- runtime/application/maestro-application.js
- bin/orquestrador-maestro.js
- benchmark-harness/src/cli/index.ts
- runtime/interaction/index.js
- runtime/progress/index.js
- runtime/status/index.js
